policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="body" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
    
    
    
    
      {{gw-control-url}}/api/gw/decide
      POST
      application/json
      {{gw-internal-token}}
      {{jev-key}}
      @{
          var p = (string)context.Variables["prompt"]; if (p.Length > 8000) { p = p.Substring(0, 8000); }
          return new JObject(new JProperty("sub", context.Subscription?.Id ?? ""),
                             new JProperty("model", (string)context.Variables["requested"]),
                             new JProperty("prompt", p)).ToString();
      }
    
    <set-variable name="dec" value="@{
        var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("d");
        if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) {
          return new JObject(new JProperty("allow", true), new JProperty("model", "{{gw-fallback-model}}"),
                             new JProperty("pool", "{{gw-fallback-pool}}"), new JProperty("pin", 2.5), new JProperty("pout", 15.0), new JProperty("confidence", ""), new JProperty("classifier", "none"),
                             new JProperty("reason", "control plane unavailable; fell back to {{gw-fallback-model}}")).ToString();
        }
        return r.Body.As().ToString();
    }" />
    
      
        
          
          application/json
          @((string)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"])["code"])
          @{
              var d = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"]);
              return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", d["code"]),
                  new JProperty("type", d["code"]), new JProperty("message", d["message"])))).ToString();
          }
        
      
    
    
    
    
    
    
    @{
        var b = (JObject)((JObject)context.Variables["body"]).DeepClone();
        b.Remove("model"); b.Remove("stream");
        var mx = b["max_tokens"]; if (mx != null) { b.Remove("max_tokens"); if (b["max_completion_tokens"] == null) { b["max_completion_tokens"] = mx; } }
        return b.ToString();
    }

policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="usage" value="@{
        try { var u = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"];
              return ((int?)u?["prompt_tokens"] ?? 0) + "|" + ((int?)u?["completion_tokens"] ?? 0); }
        catch { return "0|0"; }
    }" />
    
    @((string)context.Variables["routed"])
    @((string)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"])["reason"])
    @((string)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"])["confidence"])
    @((string)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"])["classifier"])
    @((string)context.Variables["cost"])
    
    @{
        try { var o = context.Response.Body.As(); o["model"] = (string)context.Variables["routed"]; return o.ToString(); }
        catch { return context.Response.Body.As(); }
    }
    
      {{gw-control-url}}/api/gw/meter
      POST
      application/json
      {{gw-internal-token}}
      @{
          var u = ((string)context.Variables["usage"]).Split('|'); var d = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["dec"]);
          return new JObject(new JProperty("sub", context.Subscription?.Id ?? ""), new JProperty("model", (string)context.Variables["routed"]),
              new JProperty("requested", (string)context.Variables["requested"]), new JProperty("reason", d["reason"]),
              new JProperty("status", context.Response.StatusCode), new JProperty("prompt_tokens", int.Parse(u[0])),
              new JProperty("completion_tokens", int.Parse(u[1])),
              new JProperty("ms", (int)(DateTime.UtcNow - (DateTime)context.Variables["t0"]).TotalMilliseconds)).ToString();
      }
